privacy.intro: getafjob is built from the ground up with data protection, privacy, and user sovereignty as foundational principles.
privacy.section.ai.text: getafjob uses no AI. Form values come only from your profile, your answers, your text blocks and your documents; nothing is invented and no cover letter is written for you.
privacy.section.ai.title: No AI, no invented facts
privacy.section.encryption.text: All personal data—including CVs, certificates, custom answers, portal sessions, and mailbox credentials—is sealed with a unique per-user data key. Even direct database dumps remain unreadable without the master secret.
privacy.section.encryption.title: Per-User Envelope Encryption
privacy.section.retention.text: Checkpoint screenshots are kept strictly for audit evidence and are automatically permanently purged from storage after 90 days. Expired sessions, recovery links, and challenges are purged on a 15-minute cycle.
privacy.section.retention.title: Retention & Automated Cleanup
privacy.section.rights.text: You have the right to access, rectify, export, and permanently erase your data at any time via your account settings. Deleting your account cryptographically shreds your encryption key, rendering any historical ciphertexts irrecoverable.
privacy.section.rights.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
privacy.section.self_hosted.text: getafjob runs entirely on infrastructure chosen by you or your operator. There are no third-party trackers, no analytics scripts, no fingerprinting, and no data broker connections.
privacy.section.self_hosted.title: Self-Hosted & Zero Telemetry
